question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym for the underlined word in the given sentence.**

The guest was __heckled__ by the spectators
solution:
The correct answer is: **Taunted**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Heckled **means being subjected to disruptive comments or jeers, often in a public setting. (विघटनकारी टिप्पणियों या उपहास का शिकार होना)

 
 
• **Example**: The comedian was heckled by an unruly audience member during the performance.
